provenance.sourceName: SBP C14/C15 exact-model evidence plus official Carrier, Daikin, Midea Thailand, Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, and TCL sources plus the official Daikin live product comparison page; official Carrier XPower TGV cassette catalogue (2023); verified physical, piping, refrigerant-charge, airflow and sound fields for 12 exact Carrier XPower TGV cassette pairs; exact Mitsubishi Electric PLY-M13/18/24/30/36 bundled cassette pairs cross-checked against TISI licenses and Mitsubishi installation/dimension documents; Daikin FTKF-WV2S exact model pairs and rated electrical/capacity records verified against TISI licenses; official Mitsubishi Heavy Duty Thailand residential product list and 2026 Haru Series catalogue; Panasonic Thailand YU-ZKT exact pages/2025 catalogue and XU-AKT product pages; TISI N35556-69/1529 exact supply/input records; TISI license T6961-1/1529 exact Daikin FHA13/18/24 BV2S records; official Saijo Denki residential catalogue M9/2021 with current official product-list cross-check; official TCL Thailand product_spec APIs for BreezeIN WiFi/Premium, SaveIN F1, and New Miracle exact models checked 2026-10-16
provenance.matchingRule: Exact brand and type plus exact indoor code, or exact indoor/outdoor pair in either order. Field requires manufacturer-reviewed status, exactModel=true, a SHA-256 retained for the primary source, an HTTPS manufacturer source, and an October 2026 check date. For the five Mitsubishi PLY-M bundles, the exact site indoor/outdoor pair is compared after removing only the repeated terminal TISI country suffix TH from each licensed model code; the original TISI codes remain stored. The four Daikin FTKF-WV2S records match the site catalog by exact indoor model; the exact TISI condenser partner is retained as a separate regulatory field. Panasonic YU-ZKT site rows that omit the CS-/CU- prefixes are linked only where the official indoor and outdoor codes share the exact full suffix in the catalog SKU; the explicit pair and exact manufacturer page must both agree. Saijo Denki Turbo A.P.S and Smart Cool site rows are matched by exact official family plus capacity suffix, and both published indoor/outdoor codes are retained from the corresponding exact manufacturer catalogue column; Turbo A.P.S 30/36/40 are only the single-phase non-T columns. Daikin FHFC-EV2S rows are matched only through the official exact indoor/outdoor pair in the Product Compare table; the two incorrect catalog code segments were corrected without changing company BTU bands, prices, or installation rates. TCL rows are matched only where the official customerModel selector and exact-model product_spec API agree; four company -ID suffixes were removed because TCL lists those TAC-BR model codes without the suffix.
provenance.excluded: Retailer prices, company prices, stock, installation hints, warranty terms and HTTP-only source links were not imported. Carrier kW and refrigerant-charge unit conversions are identified in field locators. Daikin manual capacity remains in source kW and kcal/h; no kW-to-BTU conversion was inferred. Manufacturer BTU values were recorded only where the official product page states them. The FTKB grouped ZV2S/AV2S manufacturer page was split only where exact ordered model-code pairs were explicit; FTKM-W phase and pipe sizes were left unstated when not shown by the checked source. Carrier TGEV cassette 4-way product IDs and exact FCU/CDU pairs were matched against the published cassette SKU. The 2025 Carrier TGEV catalogue and exact indoor-unit installation manuals were checked; interconnection wiring is 4 × 1.5 mm² or larger (H07RN-F or 60245 IEC 66), maximum 70 m, and the indoor unit receives power from the outdoor unit. The indoor manuals refer mains supply and breaker sizing to the separate outdoor-unit manual, so those remain unstated. The pictured product was not copied into the product-photo manifest because per-model image authorization is absent. Daikin FCFC-EV2S exact product-page variants were matched only when the published indoor or full paired model uniquely identified one manufacturer variant; ambiguous 30k/36k catalog codes remain unmatched. Manufacturer electrical values identify the product power-supply phase and rated input W; no rated-current, breaker, mains-cable, or interconnection-cable data was inferred from this page. Daikin FCF-DV2S catalog rows were matched only for unique exact manufacturer pairs; higher-capacity FCF indoor codes with multiple 1-phase/3-phase outdoor variants remain unmatched where the website row omits the outdoor code. Mitsubishi Electric PLY-SM36/42/48 website rows do not distinguish single-phase and three-phase variants sharing the same base model code; only identical common specification fields were imported, power phase and variant-dependent outdoor dimensions/weights were withheld. Mitsubishi Electric PLY-M36/42/48 website rows normalize to exact PLY-M codes but do not distinguish single-phase and three-phase variants; only identical common specification fields were imported, phase and variant-dependent outdoor dimensions/weights were withheld. Panasonic YN-series values were taken from the official 2025 catalogue. It states 220 V and 50 Hz but not phase or conductor count; phase, mains/interconnect cable, and breaker values were not inferred. Carrier XPower TGV was matched by exact indoor/outdoor column pairs; phase and current are published only as the catalogue states, while wire count, cable size, and breaker remain unspecified. Carrier TGF June 2023 entries were matched only by exact catalog indoor/outdoor pairs; no inverter/fixed-speed claim, wiring, breaker, price, or warranty term was inferred. Daikin FTM-PV2S capacities remain in the exact source kW unit; no kW-to-BTU conversion was inferred. TCL BreezeIN Premium ranges remain separate from rated BTU, and no model wiring or breaker claims were inferred. The Daikin product comparison snapshot showed two FCF36DV2S outdoor variants at different voltage and phase; the site row omits the outdoor code, so only shared indoor and common specification fields are recorded and variant-dependent electrical/outdoor values are withheld. The Carrier XPower TGV 4-Way Cassette April 2023 catalogue was matched by exact indoor/outdoor columns; phase, rated BTU, SEER, current and input are captured per variant, while conductor count, cable sizes and breaker remain unspecified. One public-site outdoor model digit was corrected only after the exact manufacturer table confirmed 38TGV0301A1 paired with 40TGV0301UP; the company price and service rates were retained. TISI entries are identified as regulatory records, never as manufacturer pages. M24 displays an evidence warning because the site BTU listing does not agree with the exact-pair TISI watt rating; no BTU conversion or catalog-price/capacity overwrite was performed. PLY-M42/48 single-phase site bundles lack an exact TISI pair in the inspected license records and remain unverified. The TISI-listed 6,000 W cooling capacity for FTKF24WV2S is not converted to BTU/h; its different 24,200 BTU/h Pricebook value remains visible as a review warning and the Pricebook value still controls price bands. Mitsubishi Heavy Duty image files were not copied into the product-photo manifest because image reuse permission is not established. Manufacturer room-size guidance conflicts between the current residential product cards and the Haru brochure for some YYM sizes, so no model-specific room-area claim was imported. Panasonic YU-ZKT manufacturer BTU and model identity are separate from TISI watt capacity; TISI supply/input fields were added only for exact paired rows. Panasonic XU-AKT pages confirmed only the exact 09/24 model rows present in the site catalog; no dimensions, phase, input, or wiring values were inferred from family features. Saijo Denki M9/2021 brochure claims about warranty, energy-label stars and marketing features were excluded from public model fields; the source edition is explicitly retained because the specification catalogue is dated. The H×W×D triplets were normalized to width=second, height=first and depth=third only after preserving the original reported order. Cable conductor counts and breaker values were not inferred. TCL official product_spec API captures are retained with raw SHA-256 and exact selector cross-check; Power Cord and Connecting Wiring are separate fields, not treated as field-installed mains cable; no breaker, warranty, or unmatched alias was inferred.
